name: LIBER / REVEX Observer AI session guide
flow: Fetch the discovery document and this guide before doing project work.
Receive one one-time claim key from the human/user through the AI Counter.
POST the claim key exactly once to the claim endpoint as JSON: {"claimKey":"..."}.
Keep the returned accessToken private. Do not place it in URLs, Git, project records, focus journals, screenshots, diagnostics, or evidence.
Connect to the MCP endpoint using Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>.
Call initialize, tools/list, then observer_bootstrap before other Observer tools.
Use the existing REVEX/Revit runtime owner through the active authorized browser relay. Do not reconstruct a second BIM/viewer/runtime owner.
For consequential work: snapshot -> identify invariants -> preview -> use only a registered bounded owner -> observe again -> compare expected vs observed delta -> record step.
Call observer_release when finished. The lease also expires automatically.
hardBoundaries: The Observer AI lease does not authorize model mutation.
No direct Firestore project-state mutation is exposed to the external AI session.
focusId is a task locator, not an authentication secret.
The active REVEX browser must remain authorized and open on the selected project for live Observer calls.
Unknown or missing evidence must be reported, not invented.
